budget.usage.plan.title: Plan budget
budget.usage.plan.description: Your plans’ usage windows and where unattended work waits for a reset
budget.usage.plan.none: Shows each account’s usage windows after its next Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity run.
budget.usage.harnesses.title: Harnesses
budget.usage.harnesses.description: Last 7 days of activity and where automations pause on each harness
budget.usage.stop.antigravity: 5-hour, weekly and model quota windows from agy /usage
budget.usage.stop.priced: Tracks tokens, spend and outcomes · pauses automations when a quota window is reported
budget.usage.stop.tokens: Tracks tokens, turns and duration · pauses automations when a quota window is reported
budget.usage.alerts.title: Checks and notifications
budget.usage.alerts.description: Background quota checks, Home allowance cards and drain alerts
budget.usage.drain.title: Drain watch
budget.usage.drain.description: Warns here, and on your phone when it’s set up, when an account’s last two hours of runs took twice or more its usual share of a window for the same work. Copy report puts the numbers in words for a support ticket
budget.usage.notice.hide: Hide until this window changes again
budget.usage.live.title: Check Codex & Antigravity while waiting
budget.usage.live.description: While work waits for a Codex or Antigravity plan, wisp checks every 10 minutes how its windows stand (nothing is spent). A reset that comes early, like a banked one, lets that work go at once
budget.usage.hold.title: Ask near the limit
budget.usage.hold.description: Before a task would take a 5-hour or weekly window past this, wisp asks first. Scheduled runs and crew jobs wait in Needs you
budget.usage.wait.title: Wait for the reset
budget.usage.wait.description: At a usage limit, the task waits under Scheduled and carries on in the same conversation when the window resets. Off: it stops and asks you
budget.usage.charts.title: Charts and breakdowns
budget.usage.charts.description: Per day, per harness, per project and per harness · model
budget.usage.spare.title: Spare allowance
budget.usage.spare.description: When a weekly window resets within a day with a fifth or more left, home says so and offers that account. wisp never switches for you
budget.usage.notices.title: Window changes
budget.usage.notices.description: When a plan’s usage window appears, goes, changes its length or moves its reset, a line here and on home says so until you hide it. wisp never switches for you
budget.spare.tip: Resets {when}. What’s left then doesn’t carry over. wisp never switches accounts for you.
budget.spare.label: {left}% of {whose} left, resets {when}
budget.view.unpricedNote: Codex, Cursor, Antigravity and Copilot report tokens but not cost (Copilot bills in premium requests), so their turns count in turns and outcomes but not in spend.
budget.usage.banked.tip: Reset credits on this plan, as Codex last said. wisp never redeems one: that’s yours to do in Codex
budget.usage.over.title: Past your plan
budget.usage.compare.tip: Median finished turn per account over the last 7 days, shown once each account has 5 turns on that model. Input counts cache reads. From what the CLI reports on each turn.
budget.plan.pace: Resets {when} · at this pace, runs out {hit}
budget.plan.over.api: billed to an API key, not the plan
budget.plan.over.profile: billed to a Console sign-in, not the plan
budget.plan.outsideTip: Runs of the CLI outside wisp, other apps on the same plan, and anything from before wisp kept track
budget.plan.same: {names} use about the same output tokens per turn {n}
budget.plan.more: {hi} uses {ratio}× the output tokens per turn of {lo} {n}
budget.plan.report.head: Tokens per turn by account (from wisp, {at} UTC)
budget.plan.report.row: - {account}: {turns} turns, median {output} output / {input} input tokens per turn{cache}
budget.plan.report.foot: Median of each finished turn over the last 7 days, as the CLI reported it. Input counts cache reads. Same machine, same wisp; only the signed-in account differs.
budget.plan.copied: Copied: paste it in a bug report to the vendor
budget.home.title: Usage: open Settings → Usage
budget.hold.head: {who}’s {window} window is at {pct}
budget.hold.follow: {head}. A follow-up like this usually takes it {where}.
budget.usage.silent.title: Stop a run silent for
budget.usage.silent.description: A run with no output for 30 minutes while its plan still moves is told to your phone, with Stop. Set a time to stop such a run by itself
